text: As I have done, so God has repaid me.
I have a message from God for you.
Up! For this is the day in which the LORD has given Sisera into your hand.
Please, Lord, how can I save Israel? Behold, my clan is the weakest in Manasseh, and I am the least in my father's house.
A sword for the LORD and for Gideon!
I will not rule over you, and my son will not rule over you; the LORD will rule over you.
Listen to me, you leaders of Shechem, that God may listen to you.
Whatever comes out from the doors of my house to meet me when I return in peace from the Ammonites shall be the LORD's, and I will offer it up for a burnt offering.
My father, you have opened your mouth to the LORD; do to me according to what has gone out of your mouth, now that the LORD has avenged you on your enemies, on the Ammonites.
If the LORD had meant to kill us, he would not have accepted a burnt offering and a grain offering at our hands, or shown us all these things, or now announced to us such things as these.
Out of the eater came something to eat. Out of the strong came something sweet.
A razor has never come upon my head, for I have been a Nazirite to God from my mother's womb. If my head is shaved, then my strength will leave me, and I shall become weak and be like any other man.
O Lord GOD, please remember me and please strengthen me only this once, O God, that I may be avenged on the Philistines for my two eyes.
Now I know that the LORD will prosper me, because I have a Levite as priest.
